1.why: Set pairs a restatement, a temporal filler and a causal against one true contrast, and contrast is the usual load-bearing choice here.

2.why: Only A and C put the water-only floor below the 0.5 slip-resistance threshold and the treated floor clearly above it; C has the wider, cleaner gap.

4.why: Enclosure temperature swings is the predictor an audit of outdoor clock mechanisms would plausibly isolate; the other predictors are ad hoc.

3.why: Against a summary, a temporal and a substitution option, the concessive contrast is the only one that can carry a pivot.

5.why: Consequently is the only causal in a set whose others are additive, temporal, or a concession that rarely keys.

6.why: Its rescan rates are an exact doubling (10 vs 5 percent), the cleanest authored contrast in an otherwise identical numeric set.

7.why: One contrast among an additive, a causal and an exemplifier; contrast is the discriminating choice.

8.why: For example is the only exemplifier and the set's other three are all connective types that would need an explicit pivot.

9.why: Still is the concessive in a set where Meanwhile and Instead read as near-miss distractors for it.

10.why: Largest treated drop (52 to 9) set against an untreated pond that rose, giving the sharpest statement of a main finding.

11.why: In other words is the only restatement, and restatement sets are typically built with three connective distractors around it.

12.why: Names both a sampling bias (busiest period only) and a measurement gap (no purchase recorded) - the fullest limitation.

13.why: Overnight dew rinsing dust off before dawn is the mechanism that explains a much smaller drop than predicted.

14.why: Pairs the small sample with a genuine confound (raised beds on a sunnier wall), which is what makes a summary cautious.

15.why: By comparison is the only comparative; Instead, Regardless and In that case each require a setup the others in this set do not share.

16.why: Consequently is the lone causal against an additive, a specifier and a bare contrast.

17.why: As a result is causal while Beforehand and Granted are weak fillers and By comparison needs a parallel case.

18.why: Even so is the only concessive among an additive, a specifier and a causal.

19.why: In practice is the only option contrasting principle with actual outcome; the other three are conditional or dismissive fillers.

20.why: For example is the exemplifier and In the meantime reads as its temporal foil in this set.

21.why: By contrast is the comparative contrast; Nevertheless is its concessive near-miss and the others need conditions or an instance.

22.why: By contrast is the comparative among an additive, a substitution and a conditional negative.

23.why: Specifically is the only narrowing move; Likewise, Admittedly and For this reason each demand a relation the set does not otherwise suggest.

24.why: However is the only contrast against an exemplifier, an intensifier and a similarity marker.
